ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) What is the probability of getting a sum 9 from two throws of a dice?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
In two throws of a dice, n(S) = (6 x 6) = 36
Let E = event of getting a sum
         = {(3, 6), (4, 5), (5, 4), (6, 3)}
∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S)
           =4/36
           =1/9

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) A bag contains 2 red, 3 green and 2 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that none of the balls drawn is blue?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total number of balls
= (2 + 3 + 2)
= 7
Let S be the sample space
Then, n(S) = Number of ways of drawing 2 balls out of 7
n(S) = 7C2
n(S) = (7×6)/(2×1)
n(S) = 21
Let E = Event of 2 balls, none of which is blue
∴ n(E) = Number of ways of drawing 2 balls out of (2 + 3) balls
n(E) = 5C2
n(E) = (5×4)/(2×1)
n(E) = 10
∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S)
          =10/21

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) Tickets numbered 1 to 20 are mixed up and then a ticket is drawn at random. What is the probability that the ticket drawn has a number which is a multiple of 3 or 5?

= {3, 6 , 9, 12, 15, 18, 5, 10, 20}
∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 9/20

= event that the ball drawn is blue

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) Three unbiased coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting at most two heads?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Getting at most Two heads means 0 to 2 but not more than 2
Here S = {TTT, TTH, THT, HTT, THH, HTH, HHT, HHH}
Let E = event of getting at most two heads
Then E = {TTT, TTH, THT, HTT, THH, HTH, HHT}
∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 7/8

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) In a race, the odd favour of cars P, Q, R, S are 1 : 3, 1 : 4, 1 : 5 and 1 : 6 respectively. Find the probability that one of them wins the race.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the probability of winning the race is denoted by P(person)
P(P)=1/4,P(Q)=1/5,P(R)=1/6,P(S)=1/7
All the events are mutually exclusive (since if one of them wins then other would lose as pointed out by rahul) hence,
Required probability:
= P(P) + P(Q) + P(R) + P(S)
=1/4 + 1/5 + 1/6 + 1/7 = 319/420

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) P and Q sit in a ring arrangement with 10 persons. What is the probability that P and Q will sit together?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
n(S)= number of ways of sitting 12 persons at round table:
= (12 - 1)! = 11!
Since two persons will be always together, then number of persons:
= 10 + 1 = 11
So, 11 persons will be seated in (11 - 1)! = 10! ways at round table and 2 particular persons will be seated in 2! ways.
n(A) = The number of ways in which two persons always sit together = 10! × 2
P(A) = n(A)/n(S) = 10! × 2!/11! = 2/11

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৮) An urn contains 6 red, 5 blue and 2 green marbles. If 2 marbles are picked at random, what is the probability that both are red?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
If 2 marbles are picked at random from 6 red marbles,
then the probability
= 6C2
= 15

If 2 marbles are picked at random from (6 + 5 + 2) or 13 marbles,
then the probability
= 13C2
= 78

P(Both are red)
= 15/78
= 5/26

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) Two cards are drawn from a pack of well shuffled cards. Find the probability that one is a club and other in King.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let A be the event that cards are in a club which is not king and other is the king of club.
Let B be the event that one is any club card and other is a non-club king.
Hence, required probability:
= P(A) + P(B)
= 12C1 × 1C1/ 52C2 + 13C1 × 3C1 / 52C2
=  2 × (12 × 1)/(52 × 51) + 2(13 × 3)/(52 × 51)
=  (24 + 78)/(52 × 51)
=  1/26

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) There are 10 points in a plane out of which 4 are collinear. Find the number of triangles formed by the points as vertices.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The number of triangle can be formed by 10 points = 10C3
Similarly, the number of triangle can be formed by 4 points when no one is collinear = 4C3
In the question, given 4 points are collinear, Thus, required number of triangle can be formed,
= 10C3 - 4C3
= 120 - 4
= 116

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) If <sup>6</sup>P<sub>r</sub> = 360 and If <sup>6</sup>C<sub>r</sub> = 15, find r?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
nPr = nCr × r!
6Pr = 15 × r!
360 = 15 × r!
r! = 360/15
 = 24
r! = 4 × 3 × 2 × 1
⇒ r! = 4!
Therefore, r = 4
----------------------------
Alternative way:

or, 6!/(6 - r)! ÷ 6!/{r!(6 - r)!} = 24

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) A team of 8 students goes on an excursion, in two cars, of which one can seat 5 and the other only 4. In how many ways can they travel?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
There are 8 students and the maximum capacity of the cars together is 9.
We may divide the 8 students as follows:

Case I:
5 students in the first car and 3 in the second.
Hence, 8 students are divided into groups of 5 and 3
in 8C3 = 56 ways.

Case II:
4 students in the first car and 4 in the second.
So, 8 students are divided into two groups of 4 and 4
in 8C4 = 70 ways.

Therefore, the total number of ways in which 8 students can travel is:
56 + 70 = 126
